description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation, Tolerable

Organic matter, like flesh and bone, yield to your touch like clay at the hands of an artist. The meat of men and animals quiver at your touch, eager to do your bidding. You gain access to the Trade (Fleshcrafter) Skill and may use it to make alterations to flesh and bone on yourself or others. You can make cosmetic changes with a Challenging (+0) Trade Test to do things like adjusting the cheekbones, pinching a nose, scrubbing away a scar. The GM determines how many SLs are required to change an appearance enough to create a disguise or a mimic of another person, to modify the Fellowship Characteristic or to gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.6l3jvIAvrKxt0lA9]{Attractive} Talent. You can make more drastic changes with a Difficult (-10) Trade Test, moving around muscles and fat to boost certain Characteristics or create alluring or grotesque forms. For each SL you may trade 1 point between a physical Characteristic, moving 1 Agility to Strength for instance. At the GM’s discretion you may also boost the Charm or Intimidation Skill, maybe even attain Fear, by altering the appearance. Bone can be altered with a Hard (-20) Trade Test, enabling you to change someone’s stature, height (within the Size limits of their species), create spiky bone protrusions, or simply craft items of bone using your hands. You can remove 1 @Condition[Bleeding] Condition per SL with a Challenging (+0) Trade Test. Fleshcrafting takes time, often several minutes or hours, and cannot be used in combat. Critical failures creates a negative effect, quite possibly the opposite of what was intended; a scar becomes worse, Fellowship is decreased rather than increased, the height is lowered rather than raised and so on. You can only gain this mutation once.
